Use cases / Risk reporting

Risk reporting, with a path back to the detail.

Give leadership a view of posture and organizational risk that connects back to the findings and assessments behind the summary.

Get a demo See it in the explorer

THE CHALLENGE

Why this is hard today.

Technical findings do not translate

Leadership asks about risk; security tools answer in findings.

Summaries lose their source

A posture figure is hard to trust when the evidence behind it lives elsewhere.

Every team reports differently

Separate tools produce separate pictures of the same environment.

HOW SAFORA HELPS

Three steps, one workspace.

  1. 01

    Start with the overview

    The security overview brings posture, exposure and control figures into one view.

  2. 02

    Frame it as organizational risk

    The Organizational Risk Index and Financial Risk give leadership-level perspectives.

  3. 03

    Drill back to the evidence

    Move from a summary into the findings and assessments behind it.
